textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 maths · Number Play · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Martin and Maria were born exactly one year apart. Maria says the sum of their ages is 112. Their ages are consecutive numbers. In any two consecutive numbers, one is even and one is odd.

beats.en: Martin and Maria were born exactly one year apart. Maria says the sum of their ages is 112. Their ages are consecutive numbers. In any two consecutive numbers, one is even and one is odd. So their sum is odd.
beats.speakEn: Martin and Maria were born exactly one year apart. Maria says the sum of their ages is 112. Their ages are consecutive numbers. In any two consecutive numbers, one is even and one is odd. So their sum is odd.

beats.en: The expression 100p is always even and 48w - 2 is always even. The expression 3n + 4 is sometimes even and sometimes odd, depending on n. What is the nth even number?
beats.speakEn: The expression 100p is always even and 48w - 2 is always even. The expression 3n + 4 is sometimes even and sometimes odd, depending on n. What is the nth even number?
